Los Angeles World Premiere and Review Embargo

The first wave of international reviews for the high-profile epic Ramayana has officially arrived following a grand world premiere in Los Angeles. The review embargo for the film lifted on a recent Friday night, allowing a select group of international publications to share their initial assessments.

The movie features a star-studded cast including Ranbir Kapoor and Yash. While anticipation for the project has been immense, the first batch of critiques provides a nuanced look at how the cinematic adaptation of the classic epic is being received abroad.

Praise for Visuals and Production Value

Despite mixed feelings regarding the plot, several critics heaped high praise on the technical execution and grand scale of Ramayana. Reviewers highlighted the ambitious production design and visual effects as major highlights of the cinematic experience.

Avi Offer of NYC Movie Guru commended the feature as a visually dazzling action adventure backed by strong set and costume design. Similarly, Screen Rant awarded the film a 7 out of 10, calling it an impressive achievement on a purely visual and technical level.

IndieWire and Other Critical Perspectives

IndieWire awarded the production a 'B', describing it as an epic that successfully achieves its goal of delivering the highest possible production value. However, the reviewer noted that the final product occasionally lacks a distinct voice to make it uniquely memorable.

Other publications were less forgiving of the storytelling choices. Some critics felt the heavy reliance on high-end production overshadowed the character depth, leaving certain elements of the narrative feeling mechanical rather than organic.

Criticism of Length and Stuffed Narrative

Even though the English version of Ramayana runs nearly half an hour shorter than the Indian cut, the two-and-a-half-hour runtime failed to satisfy several early reviewers. Complaints centered around a bloated and exhausting narrative structure.

Some international critics described the viewing experience as emotionally hollow and overly cluttered. One reviewer bluntly compared the theatrical format unfavorably against grand serialized television productions.

Comparisons to Television Formats

The sheer density of the mythological material prompted discussions on whether a traditional feature film format was the ideal medium. Reviewers suggested that the sprawling plotlines required significantly more room to breathe.

Next Best Picture remarked that the movie might have worked better as a television adaptation akin to Game of Thrones, allowing the narrative to flesh out its extensive cast and world fully instead of feeling overly stuffed.

Harsh Critiques and Technical Missteps

Among the tougher assessments, IGN handed out a lower score of 4 out of 10. The review pointed to clunky action sequences, subpar computer-generated imagery, and awkward artificial intelligence lip-syncing as drawbacks.

Furthermore, these critical reviews emphasized that this installment represents only the first part of a larger planned cinematic journey, leaving certain structural resolutions for future entries.

Cast, Crew, and Release Details

Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Ravie Dubey as Lakshman, and Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman. The project is produced by Namit Malhotra’s Prime Focus Studios alongside DNEG and Yash’s Monster Mind Creations.

The film is structured as a two-part release. The first part is slated to arrive globally on November 5, with paid previews in the United States set for November 4, while the second part is scheduled for a Diwali 2027 release. Sony Pictures handles international distribution outside India, and Dharma Productions distributes in the Hindi market.

Introduction to Physical Craftsmanship

While modern mythological epics lean heavily onto computer-generated effects, Ramayana also relied on intricate physical builds crafted entirely by hand. Art director Ramesh Andhale recently shed light on the meticulous work invested in bringing specific legendary items to life for the big screen.

Rather than depending solely on digital wizardry, the production team constructed tangible set pieces that required months of specialized labor. These physical assets formed a critical part of establishing the distinct visual tone of the cinematic world.

Yash's Golden Throne

Among the most talked-about physical assets is the massive seat designed specifically for Yash in his portrayal of Ravana. Reports indicate that this opulent throne required a four-month construction timeline and totaled an expense of approximately Rs 1 crore.

The stunning visual appeal of the seat came from the application of 24-karat melted gold and gold leaf finishes. This luxurious treatment aimed to capture the supreme wealth and power expected of the king of Lanka.

The Creation Process of the Throne

Constructing the grand seat was not a direct process, as the art department began by shaping a precise clay model to finalize every intricate detail and measurement. Once the initial prototype received approval, the final structure was built using durable fibre materials.

This methodical workflow accounted for the extensive duration required to complete the prop. Every single phase of development needed strict quality checks before the team could transition to the next step.

Rakul Preet Singh's Surpanakha Chariot

In addition to the monarchical seating, art director Ramesh Andhale detailed the creation of a specialized vehicle assigned to Rakul Preet Singh's character, Surpanakha. Even though the prop features in just a single sequence, the construction process lasted three full months.

This gold-plated transport carried a reported price tag of Rs 1.15 crore, placing its total cost slightly higher than the grand throne built for Yash. The significant investment underscored the meticulous planning behind minor scenes.

Functional Engineering on Set

Building the transport presented unique hurdles for the design crew because the vehicle needed to be fully operational on location. Aesthetics alone were insufficient, as the structure had to function smoothly during live filming sessions.

Engineering a working vehicle while maintaining an extravagant appearance added substantial complexity to an already demanding timeline. The team successfully blended mechanical utility with high-end cinematic design.

Scale and Critical Reception

The staggering financial resources and hours poured into props that appear briefly on screen demonstrate the immense dedication of the art department. Such deep attention to tangible detail helped anchor the mythical atmosphere of the project.

Early reviews for the feature have largely commended its striking visuals and the extensive effort invested in crafting the mythological environment. Furthermore, critics highlighted Yash as a major standout, praising his commanding presence as Dashanan.

Sustained Global Momentum

The grand theatrical venture continues to display staggering performance numbers across domestic and international markets. Observers project that the global gross for the feature on its sixth day of release will land near the 150 crore mark.

This ongoing momentum highlights the drawing power of the feature beyond the initial festive window, keeping it firmly on a path toward monumental box office milestones.

Historic Daily Benchmarks

Positioned under the direction of Nitesh Tiwari, the movie stands on the verge of establishing a brand-new precedent for Indian cinema. It aims to become the very first domestic feature to secure over 100 crore in worldwide earnings across six consecutive days.

Such steady performance sets it apart from previous major releases, demonstrating a consistent daily pulling power rather than relying entirely on opening-day hype.

Domestic and Overseas Projections

Early assessments for the Tuesday collections point toward an estimated 110 crore generated from the domestic market alone. Meanwhile, overseas territories are anticipated to contribute an additional 35 to 40 crore to the global tally.

Prior to these latest figures, the feature had already accumulated a robust 675 crore and above worldwide throughout its first five days in cinemas. This initial haul comprised 413.90 crore from domestic screens and 262 crore from international territories, though overseas numbers remain preliminary.

Approaching the Thousand Crore Milestone

With the projected numbers factored into the equation, the cumulative six-day worldwide total is expected to edge close to the 825 crore threshold.

This rapid accumulation places the title within striking distance of the coveted 1000 crore club, cementing its status as one of the most successful commercial outings in recent years.

Unprecedented Ticket Sales on BookMyShow

Beyond financial earnings, the film is creating history through digital ticketing platforms. It has officially become the first Indian release to cross one million ticket sales on BookMyShow for six days in a row.

This feat builds directly upon its stellar performance during the Diwali Monday frame, when it recorded roughly 16.60 lakh ticket purchases on the platform, marking the highest single-day count ever achieved by an Indian motion picture.

Resilience Past the Festive Surge

Industry analysts note that maintaining seven-figure daily bookings through Tuesday is a remarkable achievement, especially as the standard festive momentum usually begins to wane by this point.

The title could potentially extend this streak further, eyeing the possibility of hitting one million daily bookings on seven distinct days.

Factors Fueling the Success

Several elements have contributed to this sustained box office dominance, including a wide multilingual distribution strategy that caters to diverse audiences.

Strong family turnouts and substantial business generated from international circuits have further reinforced its position during this extended holiday corridor.

ld.articleBody:
Sunday Growth for Scene

The theatrical run of 'Scene' saw a notable positive shift as it entered its third week. On Day 17, which fell on November 22, 2026, the film recorded a 16.3% increase in its India net collection compared to the preceding day.

Directed by Jithu Madhavan, the movie brought in Rs 1.57 cr on Sunday, pushing its domestic net total past the major Rs 150 cr mark to settle at Rs 150.64 cr.

Global Numbers and Overseas Contribution

Beyond domestic borders, 'Scene' has maintained a massive global footprint. Its worldwide gross has climbed to Rs 262.42 cr, heavily bolstered by an impressive Rs 89.25 cr coming directly from overseas territories.

International markets account for 34% of the feature's total global earnings, while the remaining 66% is driven by its strong performance within India, where the gross stands at Rs 173.17 cr.

Plot and Character Overview

The narrative of 'Scene' centers around an intense character named Inbaraj, portrayed by Suriya. Inbaraj is a police officer who finds himself compelled to dust off an unresolved, highly mysterious case from his past.

To solve the tangled mystery, he must work alongside a chaotic and unpredictable team whose eccentric behavior creates hurdles throughout the challenging investigation.

Weekly Breakdown and Show Counts

A look at the box office trajectory reveals a massive opening week followed by a cooling period. Days 1 through 7 raked in an astounding Rs 111.70 cr in India net collections, powered by 39,336 shows.

The second week saw a 68.4% decline to Rs 35.25 cr across 27,752 shows, while the first three days of the third week added another Rs 3.69 cr with 2,194 shows, taking the cumulative theatrical run to 69,282 shows.

Language-Wise Earnings Distribution

Domestically, the film's collections are split across two primary language versions. The Tamil version is the primary driver, generating Rs 120.40 cr and capturing 79.9% of the overall domestic net total.

Meanwhile, the Telugu version has pulled in a solid Rs 30.24 cr, accounting for the remaining 20.1% of the domestic net collections.

Comparison With Mookuthi Amman 2

In contrast, Nayanthara's starring vehicle 'Mookuthi Amman 2' has reported a starkly different box-office journey over the same 17-day timeframe. The film registered a worldwide gross of Rs 24.83 cr.

Its India net stands at Rs 21.54 cr, with the movie adding just Rs 2 lakh on Day 17, November 22, placing its total earnings well below the massive milestones achieved by Suriya's project.

Scene Box Office Collection Day 17 vs Mookuthi Amman 2: Suriya and Naslen Film Reports Growth

Suriya and Naslen's film 'Scene' registered a 16.3% growth on Sunday, crossing the Rs 150 cr domestic net milestone, while Nayanthara's 'Mookuthi Amman 2' reached a worldwide gross of Rs 24.83 cr after 17 days in theaters.

Published 23 November 2026

Sunday Growth for Scene

The theatrical run of 'Scene' saw a notable positive shift as it entered its third week. On Day 17, which fell on November 22, 2026, the film recorded a 16.3% increase in its India net collection compared to the preceding day.

Directed by Jithu Madhavan, the movie brought in Rs 1.57 cr on Sunday, pushing its domestic net total past the major Rs 150 cr mark to settle at Rs 150.64 cr.

Global Numbers and Overseas Contribution

Beyond domestic borders, 'Scene' has maintained a massive global footprint. Its worldwide gross has climbed to Rs 262.42 cr, heavily bolstered by an impressive Rs 89.25 cr coming directly from overseas territories.

International markets account for 34% of the feature's total global earnings, while the remaining 66% is driven by its strong performance within India, where the gross stands at Rs 173.17 cr.

Plot and Character Overview

The narrative of 'Scene' centers around an intense character named Inbaraj, portrayed by Suriya. Inbaraj is a police officer who finds himself compelled to dust off an unresolved, highly mysterious case from his past.

To solve the tangled mystery, he must work alongside a chaotic and unpredictable team whose eccentric behavior creates hurdles throughout the challenging investigation.

Weekly Breakdown and Show Counts

A look at the box office trajectory reveals a massive opening week followed by a cooling period. Days 1 through 7 raked in an astounding Rs 111.70 cr in India net collections, powered by 39,336 shows.

The second week saw a 68.4% decline to Rs 35.25 cr across 27,752 shows, while the first three days of the third week added another Rs 3.69 cr with 2,194 shows, taking the cumulative theatrical run to 69,282 shows.

Language-Wise Earnings Distribution

Domestically, the film's collections are split across two primary language versions. The Tamil version is the primary driver, generating Rs 120.40 cr and capturing 79.9% of the overall domestic net total.

Meanwhile, the Telugu version has pulled in a solid Rs 30.24 cr, accounting for the remaining 20.1% of the domestic net collections.

Comparison With Mookuthi Amman 2

In contrast, Nayanthara's starring vehicle 'Mookuthi Amman 2' has reported a starkly different box-office journey over the same 17-day timeframe. The film registered a worldwide gross of Rs 24.83 cr.

Its India net stands at Rs 21.54 cr, with the movie adding just Rs 2 lakh on Day 17, November 22, placing its total earnings well below the massive milestones achieved by Suriya's project.

Security Scare at Film Board

The Central Board of Film Certification has encountered a severe data security scare after confidential materials tied to upwards of 500 cinematic titles were allegedly compromised. The exposed data reportedly remained accessible through digital archiving platforms for a period spanning multiple days before the security lapse was finally detected and brought to light.

Industry Anxiety

While initial assessments indicate that the actual media files and final film reels were not directly leaked, the situation has ignited intense industry-wide anxiety. Filmmakers, production banners, and various stakeholders are questioning the efficacy of existing security frameworks designed to protect proprietary information submitted during mandatory official compliance processes.

Exposed Scripts and Plot Points

Among the sensitive records allegedly exposed through the system are unreleased film scripts, detailed synopses, and pivotal plot points. For creators of upcoming features, the premature disclosure of narrative structures, character arcs, and unexpected twists poses a direct threat to carefully planned promotional rollouts and audience engagement strategies prior to theatrical or streaming debuts.

Censor Cut Orders

Additionally, the vulnerability compromised official records concerning censor cut orders and modifications mandated during the evaluation process. These files typically detail editorial changes and creative choices that production teams intend to keep under wraps until official public clearances are finalised, leaving creators with little recourse to manage the narrative.

Business and Commercial Vulnerabilities

Beyond creative storylines and editorial notes, the security lapse reportedly extended to private distribution agreements and intricate licensing fee details. These documents encompass sensitive commercial information for both domestic and international projects, including revenue-sharing models, intellectual property clauses, and binding contractual terms established between studios and distribution partners.

Risk of Disrupting Negotiations

The public exposure of such proprietary business data risks disrupting active negotiations and exposing confidential financial arrangements within the broader entertainment sector. Industry participants have voiced alarm over how commercially sensitive documentation of this magnitude could remain accessible through online archiving platforms without immediate detection.

Industry Reactions and Official Response

The revelation prompted swift reactions from prominent industry figures, including producer and market expert Girish Johar. Taking to social media via X, formerly Twitter, Johar publicly noted that documents ranging from scripts to distribution pacts had been exposed, confirming that the regulatory body had initiated an internal investigation and security audit to determine the scope of the failure.

The incident centers around the e-Cinepramaan portal, the dedicated online interface utilised by production houses to navigate the mandatory certification procedures. Because applicants are required to upload comprehensive project details and sensitive collateral to the platform, the breach has cast a harsh spotlight on the digital safety protocols guarding state-managed entertainment databases.

News Overview

A reported security breach on the Central Board of Film Certification portal left confidential scripts, cut orders, and distribution agreements for more than 500 films accessible on digital archiving platforms. Industry figures noted the incident, prompting the regulatory body to launch an internal investigation and security audit.

Global Revenue Milestone

The cinematic adaptation Ramayana has achieved a massive commercial milestone, crossing the 600 crore rupees threshold in worldwide gross earnings in just five days. The production has drawn substantial crowds internationally, reflecting strong ticket demand across multiple markets.

This rapid accumulation of global revenue places the title among the highest-earning recent releases, outpacing expectations set during its initial rollout.

Domestic and Hindi Version Performance

Within the domestic market, total earnings reached 413 crore rupees, propelled by a substantial surge in audience turnout on Monday. Specifically, the Hindi-language version contributed 107.50 crore rupees in net box office collections over the same timeframe.

The strong weekday hold demonstrates robust viewer retention following the opening weekend, signaling sustained interest across various regional circuits.

Breaking Previous Records

The feature successfully surpassed the previous post-Diwali box office record previously held by Tiger 3. This achievement highlights a shift in festive theatrical benchmarks for the industry.

Additionally, ticket booking platforms experienced heavy traffic, recording 1.4 lakh ticket sales within a single hour during the opening phases of availability.

Cast and Performances

Audiences and critics alike have praised the lead performances delivered by Yash, Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Ravi Dubey. Their portrayals have been central to the positive word-of-mouth driving ticket sales.

The ensemble cast brings significant star power to the epic narrative, contributing heavily to the widespread appeal of the project across demographic groups.

Visual Effects and Production

A notable component of the film's theatrical presentation is its extensive use of computer-generated imagery and digital environments. Visual effects were handled by Prime Focus DNEG.

The technical execution of the mythical elements has drawn considerable attention from moviegoers, enhancing the grand scale required for the source material.

First Look at the Netflix Adaptation

The complete trailer for Netflix's upcoming limited series adaptation of Pride and Prejudice has officially been revealed. Based on the celebrated book by Jane Austen, the upcoming project is scheduled to premiere on the streaming platform on December 3.

The preview video begins on a rooftop with Emma Corrin portraying Elizabeth Bennet and Freya Mavor as Jane Bennet discussing their future prospects. Elizabeth notes her options of becoming either a governess and a spinster or a wife and a mother before expressing a desire to converse about alternative topics.

Star-Studded Cast and Crew

The six-part production serves as a classic, faithful adaptation of the original novel. It was written by Dolly Alderton and is directed by Euros Lyn, bringing together a stellar ensemble cast to breathe new life into the beloved characters.

Alongside Emma Corrin and Jack Lowden taking on the central roles of Elizabeth Bennet and Mr. Darcy, the series features Olivia Colman as Mrs. Bennet and Rufus Sewell as Mr. Bennett. Additional cast members include Freya Mavor as Jane Bennet, Jamie Demetriou as Mr. Collins, and Daryl McCormack as Mr. Bingley.

Expanding the Bennet Family and Acquaintances

Viewers are given additional glimpses of various other residents of Longbourn and beyond throughout the footage. The preview highlights Rhea Norwood as Lydia Bennett, alongside Hopey Parish and Hollie Avery portraying Mary and Kitty Bennett.

The clip also showcases Louis Partridge as Mr. George Wickham and Siena Kelly as Caroline Bingley. The sequence concludes with a humorous exchange where Olivia Colman questions why Rufus Sewell's character, Mr. Bennett, remains entirely silent throughout the trailer.

Notable Additions and Crossovers

Actress Fiona Shaw joins the production as the formidable Lady Catherine de Bourgh. She can be spotted peering out from the back of a carriage while dressed in dark attire.

Interestingly, the trailer features a visual parallel where Jack Lowden's Mr. Darcy skips rocks on a lake. This moment mirrors a similar scene in Georgia Oakley's recent film adaptation of Jane Austen's Sense and Sensibility.

Behind the Scenes and Production Team

Writer and executive producer Dolly Alderton expressed her enthusiasm for retelling the iconic romance during the cast reveal during production. She noted that Austen's work acts as the fundamental blueprint for the romantic comedy genre.

Additional executive producers on the Lookout Point project include Laura Lankester, Will Johnston, and Louise Mutter. Emma Corrin also serves as an executive producer, marking their debut in that specific role.

A Legacy of Classic Adaptations

Jane Austen's timeless novels have captivated audiences and inspired generations of filmmakers for over 200 years. Pride and Prejudice remains one of her most celebrated works, renowned for its sharp social commentary and enduring love story.

Production company Lookout Point, a BBC Studios company led by Lankester, Johnston, and Mutter, boasts a portfolio including Renegade Nell, Happy Valley, Gentleman Jack, and A Suitable Boy.

Netflix has released the full trailer for its upcoming six-part limited series adaptation of Jane Austen's Pride and Prejudice, scheduled to debut on December 3. Written by Dolly Alderton and directed by Euros Lyn, the project stars Emma Corrin and Jack Lowden alongside an ensemble cast including Olivia Colman and Rufus Sewell.

Ahmedabad Concert Faces Child Safety Scrutiny

Diljit Dosanjh is facing fresh regulatory pressure ahead of his scheduled live performance at the Narendra Modi Stadium. The District Child Protection Officer has formally approached the Police Commissioner to place restrictions on specific tracks and stage elements.

The intervention aims to address concerns regarding content that allegedly promotes alcohol consumption, drug use, and gun culture during the live event set for November 21.

Setlist Restrictions and Track Objections

The official letter, dated November 5, specifically asks law enforcement to exclude four tracks from the artist's performance list. The requested omissions include Patiala Pegg, 5 Taara Theeke, Jeeb Vicho Feem Labbiya, and Jatt Uthe Fire Karda Jithe Pabandi Hathiyara Di.

Authorities noted that songs glorifying intoxicants should be kept off the stage entirely, arguing against the performance of these numbers even if the lyrical content is altered for the live audience.

Legal Precedents and Anti-Drug Campaigns

The complaint draws direct inspiration from the Centre's Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan initiative. It also highlights a historical observation made by the Punjab and Haryana High Court on July 22, 2019, which advocated for limits on live performances featuring lyrics about liquor, drugs, and violence due to their impact on youth.

These legal references form the backbone of the argument that live concerts should maintain a child-friendly environment free from substance glorification.

Child Safety and Stage Environment Concerns

Beyond lyrical content, the District Child Protection Officer raised distinct safety issues regarding children attending the concert. The complaint formally requests that minors not be invited onto the stage during the performance.

Officials pointed out that sound levels surpassing 120 decibels and intense, rapidly flashing stage lights could pose physical risks, such as hearing damage or triggering seizures in susceptible attendees.

Visual Restrictions on Firearms and Props

The regulatory requests extend to the artist's wardrobe and stage props. Police have been urged to ensure that the singer does not wear crossed silver bullet belts, often referred to as bandoliers, or dummy metallic cartridges across his chest.

The complaint asserts that displaying such imagery normalizes gun culture and could potentially encourage violent behavioral tendencies among the gathered crowds.

Broader Controversy and Prior Complaints

This latest development follows a similar complaint filed by Chandigarh-based professor Dr Panditrao Dharenavar, who has consistently objected to the musical choices featured in the performer's live shows.

The scrutiny in Ahmedabad also arrives closely on the heels of similar restriction requests made ahead of the artist's November 15 concert in Indore.

News Overview

Ahmedabad authorities are reviewing requests to restrict specific tracks, stage props, and sound levels during Diljit Dosanjh's upcoming concert at Narendra Modi Stadium. Citing child safety and legal precedents regarding substance and gun glorification, the District Child Protection Officer has asked police to intervene following similar objections in Indore.

The End of the Rebel Moon Mobile Game

Netflix has announced that Blood Line: A Rebel Moon Game will officially shut down, with players having until December 9th, 2026, to experience the title. Unlike typical third-party titles that exit digital storefronts due to expiring licensing windows, this project is built entirely on proprietary Netflix intellectual property. Because the experience is entirely online-driven and lacks an offline mode, the closure means the game will vanish completely with no alternative way to access it.

Developer Super Evil Megacorp has not provided a public statement addressing the termination or indicating if the title might eventually find a home outside of the Netflix ecosystem. Industry observers note that such a transition remains unlikely, especially considering that the overall player base for the mobile application was relatively small.

Development History and Release Timeline

The project was initially teased by filmmaker Zack Snyder during Gamescom in August 2023 before receiving an official showcase at Geeked Week in September 2024. Handled by Super Evil Megacorp—the studio recognized for titles like Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate and Vainglory—the release window shifted from an initial 2024 target to 2025. Following a closed beta in the spring, the top-down cooperative action title launched globally for iOS and Android on July 15th, 2025.

Designed for squads of one to four participants, the gameplay dropped users onto the warrior planet of Krypt following the events of The Scargiver. Players could choose from four distinct classes—the Bannerguard, the Evoker, the Kindred, and the Forsaken—to build a resistance movement against the oppressive Motherworld.

Audience Reception and Post-Launch Updates

Despite its slick mobile presentation, the title struggled to secure a substantial audience. When initial engagement metrics for Netflix games were published covering the period from May to mid-August 2025, Blood Line failed to break into the global top 15, trailing behind other offerings such as Squid Game: Unleashed, GTA: San Andreas, and World of Peppa Pig.

Initial post-launch support proved robust. The Dark Hunters content update arrived in September 2025 introducing fresh missions and opponents, followed by a Winter Update on November 18th, 2025. The latter drop incorporated custom banners, victory poses, and two distinct Battle Passes known as Force of Nature and Will of the Oracle. In retrospect, developer notes thanking those who fought for the future of Krypt resembled a quiet farewell, as substantive updates ceased afterward.

Broader Context of Netflix Game Removals

The shutdown places Blood Line alongside a growing catalog of more than 50 mobile titles retired by the streaming platform. This trend stings particularly because Netflix has increasingly steered its gaming strategy toward adaptations of its own original franchises, a criterion that this particular project fulfilled before meeting the same fate.

Other high-profile casualties within the streaming service's proprietary game catalog include Stranger Things: Puzzle Tales, which marked the first major permanent removal in December 2024, alongside Shadow and Bone: Enter the Fold, which was deactivated shortly before this announcement.

Current Status of the Rebel Moon Franchise

With the upcoming removal of the mobile game, the sci-fi universe currently has no active projects running on the streaming platform. Co-writer Kurt Johnstad and director Zack Snyder have previously discussed the potential for a third film, noting that continuation depends heavily on audience discovery of the Director's Cuts and a significant shift in viewership momentum.

Viewership figures for the cinematic entries showed a distinct downward trajectory. Part Two accumulated 76 million lifetime views, sitting roughly 44 percent lower than the 135.6 million views garnered by Part One, while the Director's Cuts achieved roughly 14 million views each. Although the platform has not formally cancelled the film franchise, active development appears to be on indefinite hold.

ld.articleBody:
Second Saturday Surge

The Tamil film Scene experienced a notable revival in its theatrical earnings on its second Saturday, November 14. After seeing a dip in revenues on the previous day, the action comedy jumped by 58.3 percent in its collections.

Tracking data indicates that the feature brought in an estimated ₹9.50 crore net across India for its ninth day in cinemas, giving the production a substantial boost as it entered its second weekend.

Domestic Net And Gross Totals

The latest single-day figures push the cumulative domestic net collection of the movie to ₹127.20 crore, successfully maintaining its position above the ₹125 crore milestone.

In addition to the net earnings, the film's total India gross collection has reached ₹147.75 crore, reflecting strong overall ticket sales across domestic territories.

Language-Wise Performance Breakdown

The ninth-day domestic earnings were distributed across two primary language versions playing in theatres. The Tamil language track pulled in ₹7.25 crore from 3,111 shows, achieving an occupancy rate of 46 percent.

Meanwhile, the Telugu version contributed an additional ₹2.25 crore from 1,198 shows, recording an overall occupancy of 36.1 percent to round out the domestic total.

Worldwide And Overseas Figures

Beyond domestic borders, the movie earned approximately ₹5 crore from international markets on Day 9, lifting its total overseas gross to roughly ₹79.50 crore.

Combined with the domestic gross, the estimated worldwide gross collection for the feature has now climbed to ₹227.25 crore, though overseas numbers remain provisional.

Ticket Sales And Opening Week Trajectory

Box office trackers estimate that roughly 7.16 lakh tickets were purchased for the feature on Saturday alone, taking the total ticket sales across its nine-day run past 95.38 lakh.

The picture originally debuted on November 6 with an India net of ₹19.15 crore, eventually hitting its highest single-day peak of ₹23.65 crore on Sunday, November 8, before closing its first week at ₹111.70 crore net.

Cast, Crew, And Production Details

Scene is written and directed by Jithu Madhavan, marking his Tamil directorial debut. The action comedy features Suriya, Nazriya Nazim, and Naslen in the primary roles, alongside supporting performances from Anandraj, Lal, and Raj Priyan.

The project is produced by Suriya and Jyothika under Zhagaram Studios and 2D Entertainment. It also introduces Malayalam actor Naslen and music composer Sushin Shyam to Tamil cinema, with cinematography by Vineeth Augustian and editing by Ajmal Sabu.

ld.articleBody:
The Great Trailer Disappointment

Marvel enthusiasts experienced a wave of annoyance when Disney bypassed expectations and debuted an entirely unexpected promotional video this week. With the highly anticipated ensemble picture sitting less than a month away from its official premiere, followers of the cinematic universe anticipated the arrival of a final preview. Instead, the studio shocked audiences by dropping the official look at Ice Age 6: Boiling Point.

The sudden shift in focus immediately caused a stir across social media platforms. Supporters who logged on hoping for superhero action found themselves staring at an animated feature instead, triggering a swift and vocal wave of online backlash directed at the studio.

Fan Outrage Across Social Media

Disappointed viewers quickly took to X, formerly known as Twitter, to air their grievances regarding the unexpected drop. One user bluntly expressed their dissatisfaction by stating they wanted superhero footage instead of the animated release, while another shared a looping graphic of a man angrily kicking a door to emphasize their annoyance.

Additional accounts joined in on the digital protest, questioning the studio's choice of priorities. Many pointed out that despite numerous promotional spots arriving for various other projects, the lack of any substantial preview for the upcoming crossover event felt like a major letdown.

Fueling the Hype and Expectations

Although followers felt certain a preview was imminent, Marvel had never officially confirmed that a new promotional clip would drop on that specific day. However, excitement had reached a fever pitch following statements from high-ranking studio executives.

Asad Ayaz, who serves as Marvel’s Chief of Marketing, recently shared teasers that strongly hinted something significant was on the way. His remarks inadvertently stoked massive expectations among the community, making the subsequent pivot to an entirely different franchise feel all the more jarring.

A Shift in Traditional Release Patterns

The frustration stems partly from established traditions within the studio's promotional playbook. Historically, Disney and its subsidiary brands frequently unveil the ultimate previews for their blockbuster titles precisely when advance ticket bookings officially open to the public.

This time around, however, the company threw convention out the window. Advance ticketing went live without the accompanying drop of fresh footage, leaving audiences searching for answers regarding the studio's current rollout strategy.

Alternative Promos Offer No New Footage

In the absence of a brand-new trailer, enthusiasts had to parse through alternate forms of media for any scraps of unseen content. Filmmakers the Russo brothers shared a marketing spot, but it relied entirely on previously published material rather than offering fresh glimpses.

Similarly, an official behind-the-scenes featurette released by the studio failed to include any novel shots. This scarcity of fresh content has left everyone wondering if a dedicated preview will ever materialize before the premiere date.

Massive Crossover Stakes

The immense anticipation surrounding the film is well-deserved given its sprawling scale and roster. The storyline brings together Earth's mightiest heroes alongside the X-Men, the Fantastic Four, and the people of Wakanda for an unprecedented collision.

This unified front must contend with a formidable antagonist portrayed by Robert Downey Jr., who steps into the iconic role of Doctor Doom. The grand narrative is also designed to lay vital groundwork for an upcoming follow-up titled Avengers: Secret Wars.

Disney frustrated Marvel enthusiasts by releasing an Ice Age 6 trailer instead of a final preview for Avengers: Doomsday. Despite marketing teases and traditional ticket-release patterns, the studio provided no new footage for the upcoming December 18, 2026 release.

ld.articleBody:
Introduction to Episode 8

The Great Indian Kapil Show returned with a family-centric installment in its fifth season, specifically focusing on the cast and crew of the upcoming film Yeh Prem Mol Liya. While earlier outings in this season experienced varying viewer receptions, this particular episode managed to strike a resonant chord with the audience.

Bringing together prominent cinematic figures and veterans, the program offered a relaxed atmosphere built around clean humor, relatable anecdotes, and a celebration of traditional family values on television.

Star-Studded Guest Lineup

The latest instalment featured renowned director Sooraj Barjatya alongside lead actors Ayushmann Khurrana and Sharvari, who stepped onto the stage to promote their upcoming cinematic project. Known typically for avoiding loud comedy stages, the legendary filmmaker's presence added a unique layer of dignity and nostalgia to the proceedings.

Supported by a wider ensemble of artists including Supriya Pathak, Seema Pahwa, Swanand Kirkire, Saumya Tandon, Geeta Agrawal Sharma, and Surbhi Tiwari, the couch was packed with distinguished creative voices sharing personal stories.

Thematic Focus and Film Promotion

At the core of the conversation was Yeh Prem Mol Liya, a romantic family entertainer directed by Sooraj Barjatya, slated to arrive in theatres on November 27. The discussion naturally flowed into wedding memories, personal experiences with love, and the cultural depiction of celebrations in Hindi cinema.

Given the filmmaker's extensive history with family-oriented narratives, the talk show served as an ideal promotional platform to mirror the wholesome themes embedded within his cinematic works.

Conversations and Personal Insights

One of the standout moments involved Ayushmann Khurrana prompting the veteran director about his marriage at the young age of 21. This led to a broader dialogue concerning whether the creator's real-life relationships influenced the grand wedding celebrations seen across his legendary filmography.

Kapil Sharma utilized his signature gentle teasing approach toward the famously polite director, creating an easygoing comedic dynamic that highlighted the calm disposition of the guest of honor.

Sketches and Ensemble Contributions

Beyond the main couch interviews, the supporting comedy troupe delivered sketches that successfully engaged the studio audience. Performances by Krushna Abhishek, Kiku Sharda, and Sunil Grover contributed significantly to the comedic pacing of the evening.

The supporting ensemble of veteran actors also chipped in with lighthearted banter and personal recollections, ensuring the broadcast maintained a lively and communal rhythm throughout.

Overall Tone and Reception

Unlike routine promotional stops that can occasionally feel repetitive, this episode stood out due to the genuine comfort displayed by all participants. The relaxed environment allowed the natural chemistry of the guests to shine without relying on forced gags.

The combination of Barjatya's calming influence, Khurrana's wit, and Sharvari's screen presence elevated the episode into a memorable weekend viewing experience for fans of the series.

ld.articleBody:
Formation And Path Of Cyclone Akvan

Cyclonic Storm Akvan formed over the Bay of Bengal and began tracking slowly across the water, prompting warnings from weather forecasters. The India Meteorological Department reported that the system moved at a speed of 3 kmph over a six-hour window before strengthening into a severe cyclonic storm.

Projections indicate that the weather system will continue gathering power, moving northwestwards to become a very severe cyclonic storm. Officials tracking the trajectory predict a landfall between Nellore and Tuni along the Andhra Pradesh-Yanam coast.

Andhra Pradesh Government Response

With memories of recent storms still fresh, authorities in Andhra Pradesh have placed the administration on high alert. Previous cyclones like Arnab and Murasu caused extensive crop destruction across vast acreage, inflicting nearly Rs 7,000 crore in economic losses.

Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu instructed administrative teams to keep local populations constantly updated with weather warnings. Officials have been ordered to clear fallen trees and broken utility poles swiftly, while warning citizens to stay away from vulnerable water bodies.

Rainfall And Wind Warnings

The meteorological office issued forecasts warning of heavy rainfall across various southern districts spanning four consecutive days starting November 18. Specific locations expected to bear the brunt of early downpours include Srikakulam, Parvathipuram Manyam, Vizianagaram, Visakhapatnam, and Alluri Sitharama Raju districts.

In addition to continuous rain, coastal regions face threats of thunderstorms and lightning. Gale-force winds reaching speeds up to 80 kmph are anticipated across Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Yanam, and Rayalaseema.

Current Coordinates And Timing

Tracking data positioned the storm at specific distances from major regional hubs as of Tuesday night. The center of the disturbance sat approximately 610 km east of Chennai, 630 km northeast of Trincomalee, and 660 km southeast of Machilipatnam.

Further distance markers placed the eye about 670 km south-southeast of Visakhapatnam and 790 km south of Gopalpur. Forecasters anticipate the weather system will cross the coast around noon on November 20 with sustained wind speeds reaching up to 145 kmph.

Evacuation Measures In Odisha

Neighboring Odisha initiated large-scale preparations, planning to shift more than two hundred thousand residents out of high-risk coastal and hilly zones. Disaster Management Minister Suresh Pujari led a review meeting to finalize safety protocols ahead of the impending landfall.

State planners identified landslides as a primary threat, noting that a vast majority of fatalities during the previous month's Cyclone Arnab stemmed from earth slips. Operations target foothill communities and elevated settlements located within six vulnerable districts.

Targeted Vulnerable Districts

The administrative focus in Odisha centers on six specific districts deemed highly susceptible to landslides and severe weather impacts. These designated zones comprise Ganjam, Gajapati, Rayagada, Kandhamal, Malkangiri, and Koraput.

To assist evacuation and rescue logistics, the Special Relief Commissioner's office enlisted the Odisha Remote Sensing Application Centre. The agency was tasked with supplying satellite data and GIS maps detailing vulnerable village clusters and affected roadways.

In response, Andhra Pradesh has issued widespread rain alerts while Odisha prepares to evacuate over two lakh people from landslide-prone districts.

ld.articleBody:
Commuting California's Death Row

California Governor Gavin Newsom has taken dramatic action regarding the state's penal system by commuting the sentences of 548 prisoners currently on death row. The individuals will have their punishments reduced to life imprisonment without the possibility of parole.

The decision arrives just days after Democrats secured control of Congress. With Newsom set to depart from his gubernatorial seat in two months, the sweeping measure marks one of the most significant policy shifts of his tenure.

Governor's Rationale and Moratorium Background

Explaining his choice through an open letter, Newsom stated that state-sanctioned killing conflicts directly with fundamental California values, undermines legal frameworks, and diminishes human decency. He acknowledged that an imperfect judicial system cannot reliably execute people while remaining true to basic principles of justice.

Although Newsom instituted an execution moratorium after taking office in 2019, California has not carried out an execution in two decades. Even with this hiatus, the state maintains the largest death row population in the Western hemisphere, meaning this decision successfully reduces the United States death row population by roughly a quarter.

Legal Hurdles and Anticipated Lawsuits

Because state law limits blanket commutations to offenders holding only a single felony conviction, the California Supreme Court must review and approve commutations for prisoners with multiple felonies. This requirement creates a complex path forward for the governor's executive order.

Legal opposition is already organizing against the move. Anne Marie Schubert, a former Sacramento district attorney heading the victims rights group Criminal Justice Legal Foundation, announced plans to sue Newsom, arguing that the blanket action violates the law and that every single case requires separate consideration.

Reactions From Victims' Families and Advocates

The commutation has reignited difficult emotions for victims' relatives. Schubert noted that families who found a sense of finality through the justice system now face having those painful matters reopened and rehashed.

Conversely, some family members of victims have voiced support for systemic reform. Jess Nichol, whose sister Polly Klaas was killed in 1993 by Richard Allen Davis, expressed in a statement that execution has nothing to do with personal recovery or genuine public safety, describing it as a distraction from what survivors truly need.

Spiritual Perspectives and National Context

Reverend Jeff Hood, a spiritual advisor who has witnessed multiple executions, praised Newsom's action as the height of moral leadership. He expressed hope that governors in other states carrying out executions might eventually follow a similar path.

This state-level policy shift coincides with national debates surrounding capital punishment. President Donald Trump remains a vocal proponent of the death penalty, having previously advanced plans to reintroduce firing squads and coordinate federal executions.

Broader Political Landscape

The timing of Newsom's announcement mirrors active capital punishment measures elsewhere in the nation. Florida governor Ron DeSantis has maintained an aggressive execution schedule, signing numerous death warrants while eyeing potential presidential aspirations.

With Governor Newsom also rumored to be mounting a 2028 presidential campaign, capital punishment is increasingly positioned as a prominent debate on the broader national political stage heading into future elections.

ld.articleBody:
Introduction to the Phenomenal Success

The Hindi film industry witnessed a historic surprise when Hanuman Ansh emerged as a monumental box office phenomenon. Produced on an exceptionally tight budget of just 2 crore, the movie managed to outperform several big-ticket releases featuring prominent stars like Sunny Deol, Emraan Hashmi, and Kannada superstar Yash. Defying conventional expectations for low-budget projects, it went on to amass a staggering 450 crore in total box office collections.

This unprecedented financial triumph established the feature as one of the most profitable and successful ventures in modern Hindi cinema history. Yet, despite rewriting commercial benchmarks and capturing the imagination of moviegoers across the country, the monumental scale of its achievement quickly became a talking point for reasons beyond just the numbers.

The Director Disappointed by Industry Silence

While audiences and casual viewers flooded theaters, director Vishal Chaturvedi expressed deep disappointment regarding the reaction from major Bollywood production houses. In an interview prior to the digital premiere of his film, Chaturvedi highlighted the glaring absence of official appreciation or acknowledgment from established studios and industry heavyweights.

He pointed out that whenever high-profile cinematic releases perform well commercially, standard industry practice involves major production banners issuing congratulatory statements or public praise. However, because his project was helmed by a newcomer and financed independently on a micro-budget, not a single major studio stepped forward to publicly recognize its historic box office run.

Selective Praise and Personal Encouragement

Despite the noticeable quietness from corporate studios, Vishal Chaturvedi noted that he did receive warm words from a few individual industry figures and sports personalities. Celebrities like Varun Dhawan and former cricketer Virender Sehwag personally reached out and openly lauded the film for its compelling storytelling and impact.

Furthermore, the director mentioned that everyday people he encountered in public spaces offered immense admiration for the work. These direct interactions provided a stark contrast to the institutional silence maintained by the established corporate powerhouses of the film fraternity.

Challenging Industry Assumptions at IFFI

Addressing the 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) held in Goa, Vishal Chaturvedi expanded on how his movie shattered long-standing industry myths. For years, conventional wisdom dictated that only massive spectacle films backed by heavy marketing budgets and superstar casts could attract crowds to cinema halls.

Chaturvedi explained to the news agency ANI that Hanuman Ansh successfully dismantled the myth that small-budget features must inevitably struggle for viewership. By outperforming films headlined by established icons, his project proved that content and audience word-of-mouth hold far more weight than pre-release hype.

Shifting Power Dynamics from Critics to Viewers

The director also reflected on how the ecosystem of film evaluation has evolved in recent years. In the past, professional critics and curated social media campaigns held immense sway in dictating whether a movie would succeed or fail at the box office.

According to Chaturvedi, audiences have completely reclaimed the power of choice. Viewers now visit theaters, experience stories firsthand, and independently decide a film's fate without relying on traditional gatekeepers or critical consensus to validate their tastes.

Upcoming Sequel and Digital Release Plans

Amid discussions surrounding the film's theatrical legacy, Vishal Chaturvedi shared exciting updates regarding the future of the franchise. He revealed that he is actively developing a narrative centered around Tulsidas, with future plans to explore the story of Baba Neem Karoli when the time is right.

On the distribution front, viewers who missed the theatrical run will soon have digital access to the blockbuster. Hanuman Ansh is officially scheduled to begin streaming on SonyLIV starting from November 27.

Hanuman Ansh Director Vishal Chaturvedi Questions Bollywood Silence After 450 Crore Success

Despite raking in 450 crore on a modest 2 crore budget, the blockbuster Hindi film Hanuman Ansh faced silence from major production houses, prompting critique from its director Vishal Chaturvedi.

Published 22 November 2026

Introduction to the Phenomenal Success

The Hindi film industry witnessed a historic surprise when Hanuman Ansh emerged as a monumental box office phenomenon. Produced on an exceptionally tight budget of just 2 crore, the movie managed to outperform several big-ticket releases featuring prominent stars like Sunny Deol, Emraan Hashmi, and Kannada superstar Yash. Defying conventional expectations for low-budget projects, it went on to amass a staggering 450 crore in total box office collections.

This unprecedented financial triumph established the feature as one of the most profitable and successful ventures in modern Hindi cinema history. Yet, despite rewriting commercial benchmarks and capturing the imagination of moviegoers across the country, the monumental scale of its achievement quickly became a talking point for reasons beyond just the numbers.

The Director Disappointed by Industry Silence

While audiences and casual viewers flooded theaters, director Vishal Chaturvedi expressed deep disappointment regarding the reaction from major Bollywood production houses. In an interview prior to the digital premiere of his film, Chaturvedi highlighted the glaring absence of official appreciation or acknowledgment from established studios and industry heavyweights.

He pointed out that whenever high-profile cinematic releases perform well commercially, standard industry practice involves major production banners issuing congratulatory statements or public praise. However, because his project was helmed by a newcomer and financed independently on a micro-budget, not a single major studio stepped forward to publicly recognize its historic box office run.

Selective Praise and Personal Encouragement

Despite the noticeable quietness from corporate studios, Vishal Chaturvedi noted that he did receive warm words from a few individual industry figures and sports personalities. Celebrities like Varun Dhawan and former cricketer Virender Sehwag personally reached out and openly lauded the film for its compelling storytelling and impact.

Furthermore, the director mentioned that everyday people he encountered in public spaces offered immense admiration for the work. These direct interactions provided a stark contrast to the institutional silence maintained by the established corporate powerhouses of the film fraternity.

Challenging Industry Assumptions at IFFI

Addressing the 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) held in Goa, Vishal Chaturvedi expanded on how his movie shattered long-standing industry myths. For years, conventional wisdom dictated that only massive spectacle films backed by heavy marketing budgets and superstar casts could attract crowds to cinema halls.

Chaturvedi explained to the news agency ANI that Hanuman Ansh successfully dismantled the myth that small-budget features must inevitably struggle for viewership. By outperforming films headlined by established icons, his project proved that content and audience word-of-mouth hold far more weight than pre-release hype.

Shifting Power Dynamics from Critics to Viewers

The director also reflected on how the ecosystem of film evaluation has evolved in recent years. In the past, professional critics and curated social media campaigns held immense sway in dictating whether a movie would succeed or fail at the box office.

According to Chaturvedi, audiences have completely reclaimed the power of choice. Viewers now visit theaters, experience stories firsthand, and independently decide a film's fate without relying on traditional gatekeepers or critical consensus to validate their tastes.

Upcoming Sequel and Digital Release Plans

Amid discussions surrounding the film's theatrical legacy, Vishal Chaturvedi shared exciting updates regarding the future of the franchise. He revealed that he is actively developing a narrative centered around Tulsidas, with future plans to explore the story of Baba Neem Karoli when the time is right.

On the distribution front, viewers who missed the theatrical run will soon have digital access to the blockbuster. Hanuman Ansh is officially scheduled to begin streaming on SonyLIV starting from November 27.

Director Vishal Chaturvedi expressed disappointment over the lack of official praise from major Bollywood production houses following his low-budget film Hanuman Ansh grossing 450 crore at the box office. Speaking at IFFI in Goa, he highlighted how the project broke industry myths about star-driven success before confirming an upcoming sequel and an OTT premiere on SonyLIV.

  • The film earned 450 crore at the box office.
  • Sunny Deol, Emraan Hashmi, and Yash are mentioned as having films outperformed by Hanuman Ansh.
  • Varun Dhawan and Virender Sehwag praised the film.
  • Vishal Chaturvedi is the director of Hanuman Ansh.
  • The 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) was held in Goa.
  • Hanuman Ansh is scheduled to stream on SonyLIV from November 27.

The Return of BIGBANG at the 2026 MAMA Awards

The global music scene witnessed a significant reunion as members of BIGBANG stepped onto the stage together at the 2026 MAMA Awards. G-Dragon, Taeyang, and Daesung made a collective appearance to accept the Best Music Video with YouTube accolade for their popular song "BiiiG".

Broadcasted via Mnet, the ceremony brought back artists whose footprint in the industry has spanned multiple generations. The event featured notable figures guiding the evening, with Park Bo Gum acting as the master of ceremonies and storyteller.

Presenters and Event Highlights

The award was officially presented by singer Seo In Young and idol Lee Dae Hwi. During their time on stage, Seo expressed her happiness about returning to the MAMA event after a considerable hiatus and playfully asked Lee if he would write a track for her in the future.

When BIGBANG was announced as the winner, the trio walked up to rapturous applause from the attendees. They took a brief moment to find their footing around the central microphone before addressing the audience.

Humor and Agency Acknowledgments

G-Dragon opened their acceptance speech with lighthearted humor, pointing out that it had been quite a while since the three artists stood together to receive an honor, making it slightly amusing to figure out their stage spacing.

Daesung followed by expressing appreciation to the various entities supporting their current endeavors. He noted that the members are presently signed to separate companies—Galaxy Corporation, THEBLACKLABEL, and RND Company—and thanked everyone involved in producing their celebrated video.

Fans' Choice Recognition

Taeyang took the opportunity to mention another accolade the group secured during the multi-day event. He thanked the dedicated fanbase for voting to grant them a Fans' Choice award the day prior, even though the members were unable to attend that specific session.

The acknowledgment underscored the enduring loyalty of their global supporters who continue to rally behind the group's releases across different platforms and voting categories.

G-Dragon's Striking Fashion Choice

Beyond the group's musical triumph, G-Dragon heavily drew the attention of fashion critics and viewers with his unique attire. He accessorized his outfit with a vivid red binyeo, which is a traditional Korean hairpin, coupled with a matching red floral brooch.

The distinct styling choice added a definitive artistic flair to his appearance, quickly becoming one of the most talked-about visual highlights of the entire evening.

A Legacy of Hits and Recent Releases

Ever since their initial debut in 2006, BIGBANG has accumulated a massive repertoire of iconic songs, including "Lies", "Last Farewell", "Haru Haru", "FANTASTIC BABY", "BANG BANG BANG", and "Still Life".

The group revitalized their group activities in August by releasing "BiiiG" as a trio, quickly following it up with another new track titled "GiiiRIP" just three months later, ahead of staging their latest performances at the ceremony.

Alongside accepting multiple accolades including a Fans' Choice award, the group drew significant attention through G-Dragon's traditional red hairpin styling and heartfelt acknowledgments of their respective agencies.

ld.articleBody:
Historic Global Box Office Run

The theatrical release of the epic saga Ramayana has created waves across the international cinema landscape. Featuring a prominent cast including Ranbir Kapoor and Yash, the movie has shattered multiple conventional commercial benchmarks. Industry trackers note that its steady upward momentum has positioned it leagues ahead of several contemporary blockbusters.

Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the feature film has managed to sustain massive audience footfalls both domestically within India and across various overseas territories. Its exceptional hold at ticket counters sets a new benchmark for cinematic storytelling and commercial viability on a grand international scale.

Breaking Down the Six-Day Collection Trajectory

The commercial journey commenced with an impressive opening day, pulling in a worldwide gross of Rs 128 crore. Although a minor dip on the second day brought in Rs 103 crore, the feature quickly bounced back on the third day with an enormous global collection of Rs 153 crore.

Even on the fourth day, which coincided with Laxmi Puja, the cinematic enterprise maintained its resilience by securing Rs 123 crore globally. The fifth day marked its highest single-day gross of the run thus far at Rs 160 crore, followed by a robust Rs 142 crore on the sixth day, pushing its overall worldwide tally to Rs 808 crore.

Surpassing Previous Industry Milestones

By sustaining a daily global haul of over Rs 100 crore for six consecutive days, Ramayana has officially become the only Indian film to achieve this extraordinary feat. Prior to this milestone, other major blockbusters managed shorter streaks of consecutive high-grossing days.

Notable titles such as Dhurandhar 2, Pushpa 2: The Rule, Jawan, and Baahubali 2: The Conclusion previously held four-day streaks of consecutive Rs 100 crore-plus global earnings. Meanwhile, features like Animal managed three days, while others like Pathaan recorded two consecutive days.

Regional Triumphs and Overseas Footprint

Beyond its monumental global numbers, the feature has also carved a niche for itself in localized regional markets. Trade analysts highlighted that the film scripted history in Kerala by swiftly emerging as the biggest Hindi grosser within a mere six-day timeframe.

Concurrently, the international run has proven exceptionally lucrative, with overseas collections crossing the USD 30 million threshold. Strong advance trends and positive market sentiment continue to fuel its expansion across numerous foreign territories.

Anticipating Further Records

Commercial analysts project that the momentum is far from over for the Ranbir Kapoor and Yash starrer. Current tracking suggests the production is well on its way to recording yet another Rs 100 crore-plus day, which would extend its unbroken streak to a full week.

Such persistent box office dominance underscores the widespread appeal of the cinematic adaptation. Observers will be closely monitoring how the feature fares in the coming days as it eyes further historic milestones.

Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and starring Ranbir Kapoor and Yash, the film has outperformed previous records set by blockbusters like Jawan and Baahubali 2 while making history in regional markets like Kerala.

Trade tracking indicates the movie is poised to secure a seventh consecutive day above the Rs 100 crore threshold, cementing its status as a monumental box office success.

ld.articleBody:
A Grand Reunion on the Red Carpet

The world premiere of Sunrise on the Reaping in New York City brought together multiple generations of stars from the blockbuster dystopian franchise. More than a decade after wrapping up their promotional tours for Mockingjay – Part 2, original leads Jennifer Lawrence and Josh Hutcherson walked the red carpet side by side. The duo happily posed for photographs, delighting fans and photographers who had gathered to celebrate the continuation of the cinematic universe.

The special evening served as a massive gathering for the wider ensemble of the overarching series. Several notable alumni made their presence felt on the carpet, including Elizabeth Banks, who famously portrayed Effie Trinket, Amandla Stenberg as Rue, Jena Malone as Johanna Mason, and Willow Shields, known for her role as Primrose Everdeen.

Prequel Stars Join the Celebration

Adding to the star-studded atmosphere, actors from the previous prequel installment also turned out to support the new project. Rachel Zegler, who headlined The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes as Lucy Gray Baird, stepped out for photos on the carpet. She was joined by her former co-star Tom Blyth, who had previously taken on the role of a young President Snow.

The mingling of original trilogy icons and newer prequel faces highlighted the expansive nature of the series. Attendees celebrated the enduring popularity of Suzanne Collins' literary world as it continues to translate onto the big screen under fresh creative directions.

Reprising Iconic Roles After a Decade

Reports surfaced previously revealing that Jennifer Lawrence and Josh Hutcherson would return as Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark for a specific sequence in the new picture. This confirmation meant their presence at the global debut was heavily anticipated by followers of the franchise. Lawrence later discussed the emotional reality of stepping back into Katniss's shoes alongside her longtime colleagues.

The actor expressed how surreal it felt to work with the familiar crew members and assistant directors she had spent years collaborating with. She also shared humorous anecdotes about her co-stars, mentioning how Woody Harrelson showed up at her hotel room uninvited to maintain their playful dynamic.

Plot Connections and Flash-Forward Epilogues

The narrative of Sunrise on the Reaping focuses closely on a younger version of Haymitch Abernathy, portrayed on screen by Joseph Zada, as he navigates the dangers of the 50th edition of the deadly tournament. Faithful readers of the source material authored by Suzanne Collins will recall that the story concludes with a flash-forward epilogue.

That concluding portion of the book features appearances by key figures such as Katniss, Peeta, and Haymitch himself. Based on the casting and recent disclosures, the cinematic adaptation appears to be faithfully incorporating this sequence into its overall structure.

Nostalgia on Social Media Leading Up to Debut

In the hours leading up to the grand premiere event in New York City, Lawrence generated significant buzz online. She utilized her Instagram story to share a nostalgic collection of throwback photographs taken during promotional tours for the earlier films.

Those archival images captured her traveling across the globe alongside Hutcherson and fellow co-star Liam Hemsworth. The posts offered a touching reminder of the whirlwind era when the initial four motion pictures dominated global pop culture between 2012 and 2015.

Openness to Returning to the Franchise

Lawrence previously made her willingness to revisit the role clear during a press tour for her comedy film No Hard Feelings. At that time, she explicitly stated to reporters that she would be completely open to bringing Katniss back into her life if the right scenario presented itself.

That sentiment has now manifested into reality with her cameo appearance in the newest cinematic chapter. Her initial four-movie run established her as a defining action star of her generation, accumulating a massive global following.

Box Office Legacy and Financial Milestones

The overarching cinematic franchise has established an immense financial footprint across the entertainment industry over the past decade and a half. Driven by the original four films starring Lawrence, alongside the later additions, the entire series has amassed an impressive 3.3 billion dollars at the worldwide box office to date.

The enduring commercial appeal ensures that new entries continue to draw massive global audiences. The addition of the latest narrative keeps the momentum of the cinematic property robust and financially dominant.

The overarching franchise has grossed 3.3 billion dollars globally to date.

Introduction To The Box Office Run

The theatrical journey of Udta Teer has remained remarkably stable since its global premiere on Friday. Blending high-concept comedy with the thrills typical of a spy narrative, the film has captured audience interest well beyond its opening weekend.

Box office figures confirm that the feature maintained positive momentum heading into the weekdays, culminating in an upward tick in collections by the fifth day of its theatrical run.

Tuesday Collection Breakdown

Fresh trade reports indicate that the feature experienced a favorable surge on Tuesday following a steady hold on Monday. The spy comedy brought in Rs 4.08 crore in gross figures alongside a nett collection of Rs 3.40 crore.

This latest single-day boost successfully elevated the overall all-India gross collection to Rs 31.40 crore within just four days in theaters.

Day-Wise Earnings Overview

The film opened on Friday with a gross collection of Rs 4.92 crore, setting a solid foundation for the opening weekend. Numbers climbed significantly over the next two days, reaching Rs 8.70 crore on Saturday and peaking at Rs 9.85 crore on Sunday.

Although collections adjusted to Rs 3.85 crore on Monday, the subsequent bounce to Rs 4.08 crore on Tuesday demonstrates sustained interest among moviegoers.

Audience Reception And Offers

Buoyed by positive word-of-mouth recommendations and appreciation for its quirky humor, the movie is maintaining a strong pace in national theaters. Observers note that if this momentum holds, reaching the Rs 50 crore milestone appears quite achievable.

In addition to positive reviews, the production team rolled out a buy-two-get-one-free ticket promotion, known as a BOGO code, to further encourage audiences visiting theaters.

Cast And Production Details

Directed and written by Aakash Kaushik, Udta Teer features a prominent ensemble cast led by Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan. The project is backed by prominent producers including Karan Johar, Adar Poonawalla, Guneet Monga, Apoorva Mehta, and Achin Jain under Dharma Productions and Sikhya Entertainment.

The supporting cast features well-known names such as Rahul Bose, Ram Kapoor, Gulshan Grover, Mukul Dev, Suhail Nayyar, Supriya Pilgaonkar, Brijendra Kala, and Sandeep Anand.

Critical Response And Review

Critical reception for the feature has been largely favorable, with publications like Bollywood Bubble awarding it a four-star rating. Reviewers praised the film for successfully fusing the excitement of a spy thriller with the lighthearted laughter of a comedy.

Critics also highlighted that the project stands out by proving that a spy narrative does not always require relentless seriousness or over-the-top action sequences.

Introduction to the Upcoming Project

The much-anticipated inspirational drama Aakasamlo Oka Tara continues to build significant pre-release momentum with fresh casting announcements. As excitement builds for the theatrical debut, the creative team has kept audiences engaged by unveiling key details about the main ensemble.

Positioned as a feel-good cinematic journey, the project aims to resonate with viewers through a deeply emotional narrative. Fans have eagerly monitored every update surrounding the production as it heads toward its late November rollout.

Character Reveal for Shruti Haasan

In celebration of the festive Diwali season, the production team officially introduced actress Shruti Haasan to the audience through a dedicated character poster. She is set to portray an important individual named Rohini in the narrative.

The promotional material described her persona as a vital spark designed to ignite ambitions within the story. The studio highlighted her energetic performance style while wishing fans a prosperous and celebratory holiday.

Plot and Protagonist Background

The central storyline follows a young woman named Ammulu, who is portrayed on screen by debutant Satvika Veeravalli. Raised within a conservative household, she excels academically yet faces immense pressure to abandon higher learning for traditional domestic expectations.

Her existence takes a transformative turn upon crossing paths with Krishna, a character brought to life by leading man Dulquer Salmaan. He steps in as a pillar of encouragement, urging her to pursue lofty goals that once felt completely out of reach.

Overcoming Societal and Family Obstacles

Promotional teasers have offered a glimpse into the immense hurdles Ammulu must clear to forge her own path. Family restrictions and rigid societal norms form a formidable barrier against her personal growth and academic aspirations.

Through these trials, the bond between the lead characters forms the emotional core of the feature. Krishna serves as a steadfast source of resilience, helping the protagonist navigate her challenging journey toward self-actualization.

Core Cast and Crew Members

The film anchors its performances on a diverse roster featuring Dulquer Salmaan alongside newcomer Satvika Veeravalli and the newly announced Shruti Haasan. Their collaborative efforts drive the dramatic tension of the screenplay.

Behind the camera, the production relies on a talented technical crew. The musical score is crafted by GV Prakash, while the visual language is shaped by cinematographer Sujith Sarang and editor Praveen KL.

Design and Theatrical Schedule

Attention to detail remains evident in the aesthetic presentation of the feature, guided by production designer Shwetha Sabu Cyril and art director Vamsi Krishna. Costume work has been meticulously handled by designer Pallavi Singh to reflect the authentic backgrounds of the characters.

Everything is currently on track for the feature to arrive in cinema halls on November 20. Audiences won't have to wait much longer to witness how these intertwined lives unfold on the big screen.

ld.articleBody:
The Schedule Shift

Netflix has removed the final season of its flagship fantasy series from its planned release window, moving its arrival from late 2025 or 2026 into the following year. Viewers waiting for the conclusion of Geralt, Yennefer, and Ciri's journeys will now see the last episodes arrive in the spring of 2027, with March being the most likely timeframe.

While this postponement has been attributed to complications during the post-production phase, it ultimately saves the production from a crowded release calendar. Because seasons four and five were filmed concurrently, a total cancellation was never under consideration, ensuring that the saga will reach a complete resolution.

Avoiding Heavyweight Competition

Releasing the final episodes in late 2025 would have pitted the fantasy drama against three major genre titles across rival platforms. Prime Video scheduled the third season of The Rings of Power for November, featuring the creation of the One Ring and a guest appearance by Simon Pegg as the Balrog.

Additionally, Disney+ and Hulu lined up the third season of Percy Jackson and the Olympians to adapt The Titan's Curse in late November, while HBO planned its major television adaptation of Harry Potter for a Christmas Day premiere. Facing such dominant competition, the show might have suffered heavily in both viewership metrics and critical reception.

A Historic Longevity Milestone

By extending its timeline into 2027, the series achieves an unexpected historic milestone within the streaming landscape. Having debuted in December 2019, the production surpasses the previous longevity record held by Prime Video's Good Omens, which spanned exactly seven years from May 2019 to May 2026.

Passing this operational threshold in mid-December means the Netflix production will stand as the longest-running streaming original fantasy television series in history when its final episodes debut. Despite a mixed reception and various creative shifts across its run, the adaptation remains remarkably resilient.

Background and Critical Reception

The journey to this final stretch has seen considerable fluctuations in both audience sentiment and critical reviews. Following a strong debut that established Henry Cavill as Geralt of Rivia, subsequent seasons experienced shifting audience scores and critical evaluations.

The fourth season, which aired in October 2025, left the titular monster hunter separated from his loved ones under difficult conditions. These developments led some viewers to question whether the final chapter might face sudden elimination before its completion.

The Legacy of the Fantasy Flagship

As Netflix's premier fantasy saga prepares to wrap up, its legacy is defined by both massive ambition and turbulent viewer reactions. The transition from its initial seasons starring Henry Cavill to the later episodes has charted a unique path for high-budget streaming television.

The forthcoming spring 2027 premiere gives the production an isolated window to carve out its own space in the schedule. Rather than getting lost among winter blockbusters, the series can conclude on its own terms.

ld.articleBody:
Audition Phase Continues

The latest installment of MTV Roadies 21 brings viewers another intense block of hopeful participants facing the evaluation panel. Contestants continue to step forward in hopes of proving their mettle.

The assessment puts a heavy emphasis on personal confidence, robust physical readiness, and the capacity to keep a cool head during high-pressure situations.

Roadies Rebirth Theme and Format

Titled Roadies Rebirth, the current season of the long-running reality franchise is structured around an intriguing OGs versus NewGs premise. This setup generates direct competitive friction across the board.

A familiar face anchors the production as Rannvijay Singha returns to host the show, guiding the trajectory of the latest edition through its various twists.

The Gang Leadership Lineup

Six distinct leaders share control across two separate factions, turning the recruitment process into a strategic battleground. Every single leader searches for resilient recruits who can endure intense pressure.

The established OG team features seasoned figures like Nikhil Chinapa, Neha Dhupia, and Prince Narula. Meanwhile, the NewGs side comprises Abhishek Malhan, Bani J, and Baseer Ali.

Clashes During Auditions

Promo footage from the ongoing auditions highlights mounting tensions among the leadership panel itself. Differing opinions on how to handle hopefuls regularly spark verbal sparring matches.

Notably, a promotional clip showed Abhishek Malhan intervening while Nikhil Chinapa questioned a participant named Vishu, urging his fellow leader to let the candidate speak.

Broadcast and Streaming Details

Fans tracking the episodic release can tune into the broadcast scheduled for November 13 at 7 PM on MTV. The platform ensures wide accessibility for the audience.

In addition to the television broadcast, online streaming options remain available for viewers through JioHotstar to catch up on the drama.

MTV Roadies 21 is currently airing its audition phase with Episode 9, bringing fresh drama and tension under the Roadies Rebirth theme. The season features a clash between OG leaders and NewGs mentors like Abhishek Malhan and Nikhil Chinapa.
